text:
Nora Patel: Hi team — planning parental leave starting May 6 for ~12 weeks. Two unusual asks: 1) my preferred daycare requires a refundable waitlist deposit right away. Does Redwood assist with deposits (not just invoices)? 2) possible NICU stay contingency: if baby ends up in NICU, is there a faster path to emergency Backup Care / advance?

people-ops-bot: Hi Nora! Parental benefits overview: https://intranet.redwood/people/parental-benefits. For deposits and NICU contingencies please submit the parental intake form and tag 'deposit' or 'NICU' so Benefits can prioritize.

Ben Cho: @Nora we sometimes approve one-time refundable deposit assistance as a short-term advance if you expect to get the deposit back from the daycare. Process: intake + manager approval + a signed repayment plan if deposit isn't refunded within 90 days. We'll treat it as a non-taxable advance contingent on receipts/confirmation.

Lina Morales: For NICU: we've got an emergency flow. Tag the intake as 'NICU' and Benefits fast-tracks approvals and can issue an advance within 24-72 hours for immediate caregiver needs. We also provide a placement verification letter if hospital requests employer confirmation.

Payroll Ops: If we issue a deposit advance, we'll need the intake, manager sign-off, and an expectation of reimbursement timeline. If the deposit is refunded, submit the refund receipt and we'll reconcile the advance. Advances processed within 3-7 business days normally; NICU-tagged requests can be expedited.

Nora Patel: Thanks — helpful. On the repayment plan: is it possible to set automatic payroll reconciliation instead of me having to upload refunds?

Ben Cho: Yes, with your consent we can set payroll reconciliation in the next pay cycle if refund isn't provided within 90 days. We prefer receipts, but we can do payroll adjustment if needed. That will be documented in the advance agreement.

Manager - Omar: I approve a deposit advance in principle. Nora, please add the daycare name, deposit amount, and expected refund timeline in the intake. I'll sign manager approval there. Also happy to cover your weekly stakeholder syncs weeks 1-6.

Nora Patel: Adding that now. Deposit is $300, daycare is LittleOak Montessori, expected refund if we don't enroll is 30 days. Omar, appreciate the coverage.

Benefits Team: For NICU cases: we can also provide extra caregiver reimbursement (for partner/extended family help) and extend Backup Care limits. We'll coordinate with Legal for any verification letters hospitals request. Please check the 'NICU assistance' box on the form.

Legal: Hospitals sometimes request an employment confirmation letter or benefits contact. We can produce a standard NICU/emergency leave verification within 1 business day after intake+manager confirmation. If you need HIPAA-safe wording, DM Legal and we'll adjust.

Payroll Ops: Final note: any advance will be documented and require signature. If you prefer no payroll reconciliation, keep receipts coming; otherwise we will reconcile automatically after 90 days unless notified.

Nora Patel: Filing intake now with tags: deposit + NICU. Including daycare deposit receipt and expected refund policy. Will post confirmation here once submitted. Thank you everyone. :heart:
